title: Villager Coin Loot for Graveyards & Ghosts
description: Adds Copper, Iron, and Gold coins, from VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod, to loot tables for VillagerUnknown's Graveyards and Ghosts mod.
body:
_This project will be deprecated in favor of the new built-in integration options._

Adds Copper, Iron, and Gold coins, from VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod, to loot tables for VillagerUnknown's Graveyards and Ghosts mod.

## Requirements

*   VillagerUnknown's Graveyards & Ghosts mod
*   VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod

## Installation

1.  Download the ZIP file for your desired Minecraft version.
2.  Create your Minecraft World.
3.  Install the ZIP file in your Minecraft World's `datapacks` folder.
